message.content:
Below is a quick‑look list of the **long‑weekend holidays** that occurred in Canada during 2023.  
(“Long weekend” here means a statutory holiday that falls on a Friday or a Monday, giving you a three‑day break that includes the weekend.)

| Date (2023) | Holiday | Day of Week | Notes |
|-------------|---------|-------------|-------|
| **Feb 20** | **Family Day** | Monday | Observed in Alberta, British Columbia, Saskatchewan, Ontario, New Brunswick, Manitoba, and a few other provinces. |
| **Apr 7**  | **Good Friday** | Friday | Federal holiday; creates a Friday‑to‑Sunday break. |
| **May 22** | **Victoria Day** | Monday | Observed in most provinces (except Quebec). |
| **Sep 4**  | **Labour Day** | Monday | Federal holiday; creates a Monday‑to‑Wednesday break. |
| **Oct 9**  | **Thanksgiving** | Monday | Federal holiday; creates a Monday‑to‑Wednesday break. |

### Quick Summary

| Holiday | 2023 Date | Long‑Weekend Type |
|---------|-----------|-------------------|
| Family Day | Feb 20 (Mon) | Monday holiday → 3‑day break (Mon‑Sat‑Sun) |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 (Fri) | Friday holiday → 3‑day break (Fri‑Sat‑Sun) |
| Victoria Day | May 22 (Mon) | Monday holiday → 3‑day break (Mon‑Sat‑Sun) |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 (Mon) | Monday holiday → 3‑day break (Mon‑Sat‑Sun) |
| Thanksgiving | Oct 9 (Mon) | Monday holiday → 3‑day break (Mon‑Sat‑Sun) |

> **Note:**  
> - New Year’s Day (Jan 1), Canada Day (Jul 1), Remembrance Day (Nov 11), Christmas Day (Dec 25), and Boxing Day (Dec 26) all fell on weekends in 2023, so they did not create additional long weekends.  
> - Some provinces have extra holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Ontario, St. George’s Day in BC) that can also produce long weekends, but those are not part of the federal list above.

Feel free to plug these dates into your holiday‑planning app! If you need province‑specific details or a full calendar of all statutory holidays, let me know.
